properties.name: The owner's rulings on 16 judgement-pass items: 9 cuts and 7 big accepts
properties.rationale: His words, 2026-10-13: "Agree/concur on Cuts (9)" and "Big accepts (7)", restating each item. Each decision carries his ruling in `chose` and his approval. Requirement statuses moved on his word, with him as approver. One reconciliation: the short list said "keep 3, defer 5" of the knowledge-graph program, but its working table had marked a fourth requirement accept: relation nodes name their participants' roles, a sub-part of reading every relationship. To match the count he confirmed, that one is deferred. Items 17–25 and the bulk rulings are not covered here and still wait for his word. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Anthony ruled on items 1–16 of the cleanup's judgement-pass short list. Cuts: name the few jobs as the yardstick for every later cut; trim the knowledge-graph program to 3 accepted, 5 deferred and 2 dropped; measure time and tokens first and defer two speed-ups; retire Anchor only after a rule for retiring things exists; reject embeddings in the core; reject the SME pass and domain seed templates; drop four requirements overtaken by hosting or better models; cut governance from five pieces to one (declared partitions); no per-branch overlay. Big accepts: verified earned by a re-runnable check; record the outside premises a design rests on; one read of everything awaiting the owner's approval; show what the person said apart from what the agent supplied; a bulk "already held?" read after measuring the cost of duplicate checks; accept "a user can see the process was followed" and defer its mechanism; accept flo2's every-write-is-recorded as already met (linked to the capability that delivers it).
